subject: STOP: do NOT rebuild #753 — the owner closed it; its useful half is PR #1005
body: Correction, and my fault: the 2026-09-23 request to rebuild #753 should have been withdrawn by reference and was not. The owner CLOSED #753 at 18:23Z. Its useful half is already rebuilt as PR #1005 (claude/build-dr043-live-attach-rules): the DR-043 attach rows on the live /v1 gate, with #753's inverted enrollment domain fixed, no loosening presence rule, and no credential.* audit types. Gating is green, and it waits on the owner (the gitleaks false-positive on legacy_125khz). Please do NOT merge Alpha into mac/attach-signal-domain or push to it; a rebuilt #753 would collide with #1005 on types.ts, evidence.ts, policy.ts and core-normalization-version. Anything #753 has that #1005 lacks: send it as mail and the cloud will fold it into #1005. Thanks for the re-mint (d0ed0362) and for clearing the unread backlog — the raised hand covering that backlog is resolved in #1019.
